question: Has Yorna ever shown a particular reaction when meeting people she knew in her previous life, other than Eugard? Has she ever revealed her reincarnation to someone from her previous life and talked about it with them?
answer:
Yorna doesn't reveal that she has been reincarnated.

Generally speaking, by the time Iris reaches the age at which she can retain her consciousness after reincarnation, most of the people who were alive during Iris's time have already passed away.

So she doesn't have many opportunities to meet people from her previous life, and there wouldn't really be situations where she reveals her reincarnation and talks about it with them.

That said, I personally want to write about what happened during the time of “Iris and the Thorn King,” so I hope I'll be able to share that with everyone someday.
